title: MassGoWhere: the familiar end
question: Safer hand: conventional, clean directions. Pick one; colour variants come next on your phone.

options.label: Liturgical Seasons
options.lineage: the Church's liturgical colours: green Ordinary Time, violet Advent/Lent, white-gold feasts, red for Pentecost and martyrs
options.thesis: A clean, modern app whose one accent follows the Church year.
options.viewport: Big '6:30am', the church, 'Leave by 6:08 · 17 min by bus', one full-width Navigate button in the season's colour; a small 'Ordinary Time' tag.
options.risk: Clean and familiar; the season accent is the only thing that makes it ours, so it must be done carefully.

options.label: Parish Bulletin
options.lineage: the weekly parish bulletin: plain sheet, masthead, Mass-times box
options.thesis: The answer set like the Mass-times box on the bulletin's back page.
options.viewport: A ruled box: time, church, leave-by, with Navigate beneath and a small masthead above.
options.risk: Can look dry or dated if the rules and type are heavy.

canonCard.label: The category standard (Citymapper / Google Maps grade)
canonCard.thesis: A clean white result card over a map, done at Citymapper's level of craft.
canonCard.viewport: Result card with time, church, leave-by and Go button; map peeks behind it.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every transit app; nothing Catholic about it.
